item.title: Shoe Boxes for Shipping
item.description: A courier drops a parcel at the door and your customer picks it up, turns it over, runs a thumb along the edge, and forms a view about your brand before the tape is broken. If the box has held its shape, if the corners are still crisp, if the exterior print is exactly what it was when it left your warehouse, that view is a good one.
